title: Create: Dyed Experience Blocks
description: A Create addon that adds colored variants of the Block of Experience
body:
A small [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) mod addon that adds variants of Create's Block of Experience (pretty cool light block) in all 16 Minecraft colors. Can be crafted in batches of 8 or one by one, and even in world by clicking on any Block of Experience with any Dye of your desired color. Also can be uncrafted back into Nuggets of Experience, thus removing the color.

Requires: [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)

1.21.1 NeoForge is planned to release eventually
